text: Example storyboards carry no start/dur/feel: transition timing is derived from grammar role + board.totalDurationSec (uniform split).
On the example boards zoom/push-in lives in beat.cameraMove, not beat.show; relation inference must read cameraMove.
tokens.motion.feels carry no easing curve, so transition progress is linear in u until a feel supplies a monotone 4-tuple.
callback kind = REVERSE[table.hook], derived in code, never typed as a literal.
Every transition window is clamped to min(fromBeat.dur, toBeat.dur) and centred on toBeat.start, so consecutive windows cannot overlap.
transitionFor returns relation, because and feel beside the contract fields {kind, semantic, t0, t1, focus?}.
Iris polygons divide the radius by cos(pi/N) so that coverage(u=1) = 1 over the full frame.
G31: the two.js layer returns null and touches nothing when Two is absent.
sed "s/breather: 'cut',/breather: 'wipe',/" on the lane module must flip predicate 2 (breather -> cut) to FAIL.
